description_en: You can use this API to change the number of Compute Units (CUs) in a compute group of a Serverless StarRocks instance
description_zh: 本接口用于修改 Serverless StarRocks 实例计算组节点的 CU 数量
kebab_example: aliyun starrocks modify-cu --instance-id c-b25e21e243880000 --node-group-id ng-3d5ce64543540000 --target 4 --fast-mode true --promotion-option-no example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCu

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to restart the instance in fast restart mode. The default value is false.

true: Restarts the compute nodes in fast restart mode. The compute nodes are restarted in batches. Nodes within a batch are restarted in parallel, and batches are processed sequentially.

false: Restarts the compute nodes in rolling restart mode
parameters.help_zh:
是否以快速重启模式重启。默认为 false。

true：以快速重启模式重启计算节点。分为多个批次重启计算节点，批次内并行重启，批次间串行执行；
false：以滚动重启模式重启计算节点
parameters.name: fast_mode
